div.head: Duns 8.2
div.ab: ⁊ se ðe hit tyme, sylle ana ðone að, þæt he hit to ðære handa tyme, þe him sealde.
Et qui aduocat, unus et solus iuret, quod ad manum illam uocet, que uendidit ei.
Und wer es zur Gewähr schiebt, leiste für sich allein folgenden Eid: ‘dass er es zu dér Hand schiebe, die [es] ihm veräussert hat’.
And let whoever vouches it to warranty give the following oath alone: ‘that he vouches it to the hand which sold [it] to him’.
And he who guarantees it [the security sworn to] must swear alone the oath: that he warrants that sold the cattle to the person (accuser).
